# wasabi_bucket_versioning (Resource)

Manages the versioning state of a bucket. Do not use it together with the inline `versioning` block of `wasabi_bucket` on the same bucket, because the two would overwrite each other's configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wasabi_bucket" "example" {
  bucket = "example-bucket"
}

resource "wasabi_bucket_versioning" "example" {
  bucket = wasabi_bucket.example.id

  versioning_configuration {
    status = "Enabled"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket` (String) The name of the bucket.
- `versioning_configuration` (Block List, Min: 1, Max: 1) The versioning configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--versioning_configuration))

### Optional

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--versioning_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `versioning_configuration`

Required:

- `status` (String) The versioning state, `Enabled` or `Suspended`. A bucket that has never had versioning enabled is reported as `Disabled`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import wasabi_bucket_versioning.example example-bucket
```
